name: Jupiter

requiredConfig.name: JUPITER_API_KEY or JUP_API_KEY
requiredConfig.description: Required for Jupiter Swap API v2 order previews, Token API V2 reads, Price API V3 reads, prepared swaps, and swap execution.

requiredConfig.name: Dialect client key
requiredConfig.description: Not used by MCP Jupiter support. Lend Earn and Borrow are first-class via REST and the @jup-ag/lend SDK; no Dialect dependency.

requiredConfig.name: @jup-ag/lend optional dependency
requiredConfig.description: Optional Jupiter Lend SDK. Required for Borrow writes and SDK-backed Borrow reads. Earn REST reads work without it; missing SDK degrades Borrow capabilities with sdkUnavailable.

requiredConfig.name: JUPITER_LEND_USE_SDK
requiredConfig.description: Optional boolean (true|false). Defaults to true. Set to false to force REST-only Earn reads even when the SDK is installed.

requiredConfig.name: JUPITER_TRIGGER_BASE_URL
requiredConfig.description: Optional override for the Jupiter Trigger V2 base URL. Defaults to https://api.jup.ag/trigger/v2.

requiredConfig.name: CONNECTORS_JUPITER_TRIGGER_ENABLED
requiredConfig.description: Set true to enable Jupiter Trigger V2 reads and prepared actions. Disabled by default; mirrors connectors.jupiter.trigger.enabled in agent-wallet.config.json.

requiredConfig.name: JUPITER_RECURRING_BASE_URL
requiredConfig.description: Optional override for the Jupiter Recurring base URL. Defaults to https://api.jup.ag/recurring/v1.

requiredConfig.name: CONNECTORS_JUPITER_RECURRING_ENABLED
requiredConfig.description: Set true to enable Jupiter Recurring native DCA reads and prepared actions. Disabled by default; mirrors connectors.jupiter.recurring.enabled in agent-wallet.config.json.

requiredConfig.name: connectors.jupiter.recurring.maxDepositAmount
requiredConfig.description: Optional per-mint or wildcard cap for the total input amount deposited into a Jupiter Recurring order.

requiredConfig.name: CONNECTORS_JUPITER_RECURRING_MAX_ORDER_COUNT
requiredConfig.description: Optional maximum numberOfOrders policy override for Jupiter Recurring. Defaults to 100.

requiredConfig.name: CONNECTORS_JUPITER_RECURRING_MAX_LIFETIME_DAYS
requiredConfig.description: Optional maximum total Jupiter Recurring order lifetime in days.

requiredConfig.name: CONNECTORS_JUPITER_RECURRING_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS
requiredConfig.description: Optional minimum interval between Jupiter Recurring fills. Defaults to 3600 seconds.

requiredConfig.name: CONNECTORS_JUPITER_RECURRING_ALLOW_DEPRECATED_PRICE_ORDERS
requiredConfig.description: Optional boolean. Controls whether deprecated Jupiter Recurring price-order deposit/withdraw management is exposed after explicit user acceptance.

actionPreparationNotes: Normalize SOL to wrapped SOL for Jupiter Swap API v2, resolve allowlisted symbols or mint decimals, enforce maxSwapInput and maxSlippageBps, then prepare a swap inbox item with refreshAtExecution=true. For previews, call Jupiter /order with taker, inputMint, outputMint, amount, and slippageBps. Raw or unknown swap mints should include Jupiter token-risk evidence facts when available, without blocking the quote if token evidence is unavailable. Do not store raw transaction bytes in prepared actions or expose them in findings. For Trigger V2: authenticate via solana_jupiter_trigger_auth_challenge then solana_sign_message then solana_jupiter_trigger_auth_verify before any vault/order read or prepared action. JWTs live only in volatile process memory and are clamped to 23h. Prepared deposit transactions are re-fetched at execute time, signed locally via ctx.signTransaction, then POSTed back to Jupiter Trigger which broadcasts the deposit on-chain. For Recurring: create/cancel/price-management transactions are prepared approval items, refreshed at execute time, signed locally, and POSTed to Jupiter Recurring /execute with the request id. Do not store JWTs, signed challenges, signed transaction bytes, or API keys anywhere.
riskNotes: Quotes can expire or change before approval. Price impact, minimum output, and slippage must be shown. Unknown token mints should be displayed as short mints unless exact metadata is available. Jupiter Token/Price data is review evidence only; it can be missing, stale, or heuristic-filtered and must not be presented as an oracle guarantee. Non-exact Token API search hits must be presented as candidates, not as evidence for the requested mint. Jupiter Perps are leveraged derivatives; liquidation can cause complete loss of posted collateral and writes are denied until the official API stabilizes and a leverage-risk policy is approved. Jupiter Trigger V2 stores order funds in a Privy-managed custody vault; future fills execute through Jupiter automation outside the Agentic approval inbox. Output is not guaranteed at trigger time. Cancel and withdrawal are separate steps; expired or cancelled funds remain in the vault until the user completes the withdraw flow. Jupiter Recurring is Jupiter-native DCA automation; after setup approval, future fills execute through Jupiter without returning to Agentic each cycle. Jupiter Recurring charges a 0.1% fee and price-based orders are deprecated.
walletApprovalBoundary: Jupiter previews and Token/Price reads are read-only. Token/Price reads never prepare, approve, sign, or execute transactions. Prepared swaps stay in the approval inbox until the user sends them to the wallet. The wallet signs and broadcasts; the agent does not. Jupiter Trigger V2 auth requires a wallet message signature via solana_sign_message and the JWT is held only in volatile process memory. Trigger order deposits are signed locally then handed back to Jupiter for broadcast, and order funds live in a Jupiter-managed Privy custody vault until withdrawal completes. Jupiter Recurring setup/cancel/deprecated price management requires wallet transaction approval; future DCA fills after setup are executed by Jupiter automation.

mirrorsCanonical.note: Browser catalog lists Jupiter as first-class for Swap API v2, Lend Earn/Borrow, Token/Price, beta Prediction, Trigger V2, Perps read-only status, and Recurring native DCA. Trigger and Recurring are disabled by default until the host opts in.
